content.title: Saba Capital Management Reduces Stake in Invesco Municipal Trust
content.summary: On September 23, 2024, Saba Capital Management, L.P. (Trades, Portfolio), a prominent investment firm based in New York, executed a significant transaction involving the sale of 440,409 shares of Invesco Municipal Trust (NYSE:VKQ).  Saba Capital Management, L.P. (Trades, Portfolio) operates from its headquarters at 405 Lexington Avenue, New York, NY.  The firm is known for its diverse investment strategies across various sectors, with a significant focus on Financial Services and Communication Services.
